nodes.description: Ownable owner address; controls onlyOwner functions and receives royalty/revenue payouts.
Optional address allowed to sign mint/sale authorisations alongside the owner.
Secondary-sale royalty basis points paid to the collection owner, capped by MAX_SECONDARY_BPS.
Array of addresses receiving a share of primary sales.
Array of basis points for the primary revenue share, bounded by MAX_ROYALTIES_BPS.
Signing version per address, used to mass-invalidate signed orders.
Replay-protection map marking hashes as cancelled or already completed.
Maximum number of tokens that may ever be minted; can be locked at reveal time.
Maximum number of tokens a single wallet may mint (0 means unlimited).
Maximum number of tokens mintable in a single transaction (capped at 100).
Per-address mint counter used to enforce maxMint.
Random shuffle offset applied to tokenIds once the collection is revealed.
Base id added to randomly minted tokens acquired before reveal.
Large index-swap array enabling constant-time random minting without duplicates.
IPFS directory hash used as the tokenURI base, set once at reveal.
Flag controlling whether tokenURI and minting use random/shuffled logic.
Cumulative minted counter, updated manually by the minting routines.
Cumulative burned counter used by totalSupply.
Token balance per owner, updated manually rather than inside _mint.
Token id to owner mapping.
Flag enabling or disabling holder burns.
Guard flag ensuring _init can only run once.
Hardcoded EaselyPayout contract address that splits payouts.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, minting, refunds and randomness entropy.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for descending prices and randomness entropy.
Public/external initializer that delegates to _init; only effective once.

Constructor taking bools/addresses/uints/strings arrays and calling _init.
Lets a token owner burn their token when burnable is enabled.

Returns the metadata URI, applying the reveal offset when revealed.
Returns the allow-list order hash for the valid signer to sign.
Invalidates an allow-list signature hash.
Payable allow-list mint verifying version, hash, signature and per-wallet/transaction limits.

Invalidates a public mint signature hash.

Applies the eth_sign prefix to the allow-list hash.
Builds the allow-list order hash bound to this chain and contract.
Applies the eth_sign prefix to the public mint hash.
Builds the public mint order hash bound to this chain and contract.
Swap-and-pop loop minting unique pseudo-random token ids and updating the index mapping.
Pseudo-random generator seeded with msg.sender, difficulty, timestamp and previous blockhash.
Wrapper enforcing maxMint and doing manual balance/supply accounting around minting.
Permissionless function pushing the contract balance into the payout splitter.
Owner-only setter for the alternate signer address.
Owner-only setter for revenue-share addresses and basis points.
Owner-only setter for the secondary royalty basis points.
Lets any caller rotate their own signing version, invalidating prior signatures.
Returns the hash a token owner must sign to enable a secondary sale.
Payable secondary-sale execution: verifies signature, transfers the token, splits payment and refunds change.
Cancels a previously generated secondary-sale hash.
Computes the descending sale price from the supplied prices and timestamps.
Internal royalty setter; the guard compares the old value instead of the new one.
Internal revenue-share setter enforcing a combined basis-point cap.
Requires the signer to be the owner or the alternate signer.
Verifies the sale hash is unused and signed by the token owner, then marks it finalized.
Builds the raw secondary-sale order hash.
Applies the eth_sign prefix to the secondary-sale hash.
Internal ownership transfer updating balances, approvals and supplying the hook.
Internal mint that then calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
Internal mint writing _owners without updating balances or supply.
Internal burn clearing approvals, deleting ownership and adjusting balances/supply.
Invokes onERC721Received on contract recipients, a reentrancy entry point.
Empty hook called before every mint, transfer and burn.

IEaselyPayout.splitPayable{value: currentPrice} external call with arbitrary royalty arrays in buyToken.
External value call forwarding the whole contract balance to the payout contract in a permissionless function.
Payable refund of msg.value - totalPrice to the caller in mint.
Payable refund of msgValue - totalPrice to the caller in mintAllow.
Raw ecrecover opcode inside ECDSA.tryRecover; returns address(0) on failure and is malleability sensitive.

Signature recovery inside mintAllow, gated by _checkValidSigner.
Signature recovery inside public mint, gated by _checkValidSigner.
buyToken parameter identifying the seller whose token is purchased.
buyToken parameter carrying the seller signature.
Array of starting/ending prices and timestamps consumed by _currentPrice.

updateVersion parameter written into _addressToActiveVersion.
setRoyaltiesBPS parameter written into ownerRoyaltyBPS.
Price computed by _currentPrice during buyToken.
Order hash computed inside _markHashSold.
Random index used to read the swap mapping in _mintRandomIndex.

edges.reason: Constructor/_init assign _owner from msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged owner.
_init writes alternateSignerAddress from the deployer-supplied address array.
updateVersion writes _addressToActiveVersion[_msgSender()], letting any caller rotate their signing version.
mintCount is keyed by msg.sender to enforce per-wallet mint limits.
buyToken derives the buyer from msg.sender, transfers the token to it and refunds it.
mintAllow requires allowedAddress == _msgSender() before minting.
mint delivers tokens to _msgSender().
Randomness seed includes msg.sender, so the caller can bias the result.
burn requires ownerOf(tokenId) == _msgSender().
block.timestamp determines the current price; miners can nudge it.
block.timestamp is used as randomness entropy.
buyToken computes the sale price via _currentPrice.
buyToken validates the seller signature through _markHashSold.
buyToken transfers the token after the hash is marked sold.
External value call to the payout contract after state updates inside buyToken.
Excess ETH is pushed to the buyer with transfer at the end of buyToken.
The recovered signer must equal the token owner.
_markHashSold builds the hash via _hashToCheckForSale.
The hash is stored in _cancelledOrFinalizedSales to block replay.
mintAllow recovers the signer from the signature and requires a valid signer.
Recovered signer checked against owner()/alternateSignerAddress.
Signature hash marked used to prevent replay of the allow-list order.
version must equal _addressToActiveVersion[owner()].
mintAllow mints tokens through _mintRandom.
Excess ETH refunded to the caller at the end of mintAllow.
Builds the allow-list hash to verify.
transactionMax caps buyAmount per transaction in mintAllow.
mint recovers the signer from the caller-supplied signature.
Recovered signer must be owner or alternate signer.
mint prices tokens with the timestamp-dependent _currentPrice.
mint mints tokens through _mintRandom.
Excess ETH refunded to the caller at the end of mint.
version must match the active version of the owner.
Sale hash must not be cancelled or already finalised.
Builds the public mint hash to verify.
buyAmount bounded by transactionMax in mint.
hashToSignForAllowList restricted to owner/alternate signer.
cancelAllowList restricted to owner/alternate signer.
hashToSignForMint restricted to owner/alternate signer.
cancelMint restricted to owner/alternate signer.
Wraps _hashForAllowList with the eth_sign prefix.
Wraps _hashForMint with the eth_sign prefix.
_hashToCheckForSale wraps _hashForSale.
hashToSignToSellToken returns the raw sale hash.
cancelSale recomputes the hash to cancel.
cancelSale marks the hash as cancelled in _cancelledOrFinalizedSales.
setAltSigner (onlyOwner) rewrites the alternate signer.
setRevenueShare is onlyOwner and delegates to the internal setter.
setRoyaltiesBPS is onlyOwner and delegates to the internal setter.
Writes ownerRoyaltyBPS used by royaltyInfo and secondary payouts.
require(newBPS[0] + newBPS[1] <= MAX_ROYALTIES_BPS) bounds the combined split.
Writes the revenueShare address list.
Anyone may trigger the payout external call.
Withdrawal is routed to owner()/revenue share, not to the caller.
withdrawAmount bounds the external payout.
lockTokenURI sets the reveal offset once.
isRevealed can only be flipped once, by the owner.
lockOnReveal caps maxSupply at the already-minted count.
Stores the revealed IPFS hash.
offset comes from _random.
randOffset records _totalMinted so revealed randomness starts later.
tokenURI branches on isRevealed.
tokenURI applies the reveal offset to the tokenId.
tokenURI takes the offset modulo maxSupply.
Enforces maxMint and increments mintCount.
maxMint limits mints per wallet.
Revealed path uses random-index minting.
Unrevealed path mints sequentially via _safeMint.
_balances[buyer] += amount is updated manually, bypassing _mint.
_totalMinted += amount is updated manually, bypassing _mint.
Random index derived from modulo of the entropy hash.
Reads and writes the swap-and-pop index mapping.
Mints the derived random tokenId.
randOffset is added to the derived tokenId.
supplyLeft bounds the shuffle range.
Public init delegates to _init.
Constructor delegates to _init.
Public init can only succeed once because hasInit is already set.
require(!hasInit) guard prevents re-initialisation of owner, signer and royalty settings.
Revenue is routed to the hardcoded PAYOUT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS.
maxSupply must stay below MAX_SUPPLY_LIMIT.
_init sets _owner to msg.sender.
burnable flag is set at init.
burn is gated on the burnable flag.
_burn decrements the owner balance.
_totalBurned increments on burn.
_mint writes _owners[tokenId].
_transfer calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Signature recovery delegates to the ecrecover precompile inside ECDSA.
mintAllow signature recovery delegates to ecrecover.
mint signature recovery delegates to ecrecover.
hashToSignToSellToken requires _msgSender() == ownerOf(tokenId).
hashToSignToSellToken reads token ownership from _owners.
seller argument selects whose token and whose signature is required.
Caller-supplied signature is fed into recovery; an invalid one fails the check.
Caller-supplied prices/timestamps define the price and are only bound by the seller signature.
signer compared against owner() and alternateSignerAddress.
version argument written into _addressToActiveVersion.
newBPS written into ownerRoyaltyBPS.
Locally computed currentPrice is forwarded as msg.value to the external payout call.
buyToken computes currentPrice = _currentPrice(pricesAndTimestamps).
Local hash is produced inside _markHashSold.
Local hash is used as the finalized-sale key.
Random index reads the swap mapping.
rand % max bounds the returned randomness.
Recovered signer used for the access-control check in mint.
_safeMint calls IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient, executing external code.
A malicious receiver can re-enter the mint entry point before balance/supply accounting completes.
The EaselyPayout contract can call back into buyToken while the refund is still pending.
The EaselyPayout contract can re-enter withdrawBalance.

normalization_plan.reason: seller is a buyToken argument used only inside buyToken for the signature/owner check and the transfer.
signature is a buyToken argument consumed immediately by the recovery check.
pricesAndTimestamps is the sole argument of _currentPrice and belongs to that core function.
withdrawAmount is the withdrawBalance argument bounding the payout call.
signer is the _checkValidSigner argument performing the access-control comparison.
version is the updateVersion argument written into _addressToActiveVersion.
newBPS is the _setRoyaltiesBPS argument written into ownerRoyaltyBPS.
currentPrice is a buyToken local that flows into the payout call and the refund.
hash is a _markHashSold local keying the cancelled/finalized mapping.
index is a _mintRandomIndex local indexing the swap mapping.
rand is the _random local holding the entropy hash.
signer is the mint local used for the access-control check.
supplyLeft is a _mintRandomIndex local bounding the shuffle range.
